note: Every spoken line, exactly as written. "say" is what is spoken: (beat) becomes a pause, other parentheticals are directions. Shots are filled in when the shot list exists. Voice DNA: design/VOICE_BIBLE.md.

lines.speaker: C05
lines.name: The Hierophant
lines.script: Heaven chose us from the earth and raised us above the unworthy. What heaven has raised --
lines.say: Heaven chose us from the earth and raised us above the unworthy. What heaven has raised --
lines.direction: Liturgical, sung-spoken, unhurried; falls on "raised" and is cut off by the response.

lines.speaker: K01
lines.name: The ten thousand
lines.script: Let no hand bring down.
lines.say: Let no hand bring down.
lines.direction: Ten thousand in unison, murmured not shouted; habit, not passion; a long tail.

lines.speaker: C08
lines.name: The Engineer
lines.script: Six hundred feet since dawn. The Unrisen hold the Weir at Sarn. They are closing it against our weight.
lines.say: Six hundred feet since dawn. The Unrisen hold the Weir at Sarn. They are closing it against our weight.
lines.direction: A number given like an apology.

lines.speaker: C05
lines.name: The Hierophant
lines.script: Then let it be broken.
lines.say: Then let it be broken.
lines.direction: Simple, untroubled.

lines.speaker: C08
lines.name: The Engineer
lines.script: It would take every gun in the fleet. And -- Holiness, a Weir is a sluice, not a prop. Close it, and our weight backs up on us. Break it, and it pours. All of it, at once, onto the lowest ground. (he would rather not say it) Sarn Vale. It is not bearing-land. Nothing there is built for it. But we would hold our height.
lines.say: It would take every gun in the fleet. And -- Holiness, a Weir is a sluice, not a prop. Close it, and our weight backs up on us. Break it, and it pours. All of it, at once, onto the lowest ground. Sarn Vale. It is not bearing-land. Nothing there is built for it. But we would hold our height.
parentheticals: he would rather not say it
lines.direction: Hesitant; stops and restarts at "And --"; exact on the mechanism; the longest pause before "Sarn Vale".

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: Forty thousand people live in Sarn Vale.
lines.say: Forty thousand people live in Sarn Vale.
lines.direction: Even and factual: the first time she weighs anything.

lines.speaker: C05
lines.name: The Hierophant
lines.script: And four million here. Heaven has done your arithmetic for you.
lines.say: And four million here. Heaven has done your arithmetic for you.
lines.direction: Gently, as a kindness.

lines.speaker: C06
lines.name: The Chancellor
lines.script: I will not call it clean. I have grandchildren on the lower terraces. (to Serath) Break it.
lines.say: I will not call it clean. I have grandchildren on the lower terraces. Break it.
lines.direction: Plain; a slight tremor on "grandchildren", then quiet and final.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: Give me until the evening bell. If they give back the Weir, nobody dies on either side. If they do not, I break it.
lines.say: Give me until the evening bell. If they give back the Weir, nobody dies on either side. If they do not, I break it.
lines.direction: Measured; a bargain stated, not pleaded.

lines.speaker: C05
lines.name: The Hierophant
lines.script: Until the bell. If it finds the Weir standing, the fleet is Vice Admiral Cassiel's. (beat) And Admiral. Whatever they show you down there, remember who raised you.
lines.say: Until the bell. If it finds the Weir standing, the fleet is Vice Admiral Cassiel's. ... And Admiral. Whatever they show you down there, remember who raised you.
lines.direction: Pronouncement, then warm; a warning she does not hear as one.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: Admiral. You will want to sit down. Everyone does, the first time. (she does not) It is only your own weight. Down here that is a light day.
lines.say: Admiral. You will want to sit down. Everyone does, the first time. It is only your own weight. Down here that is a light day.
lines.direction: From the door's shadow; tired, dry, almost kind.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: You hold an imperial Weir. Return it by the evening bell and I will take your surrender on generous terms.
lines.say: You hold an imperial Weir. Return it by the evening bell and I will take your surrender on generous terms.
lines.direction: Formal, upright, the breath heavier than above.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: We did not attack your city, Admiral. We stopped carrying it.
lines.say: We did not attack your city, Admiral. We stopped carrying it.
lines.direction: Flat, tired, no triumph.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: "...the seven cities, raised by the hands of all, and borne by the nations of the high ground, until the fire is stone."
lines.say: "...the seven cities, raised by the hands of all, and borne by the nations of the high ground, until the fire is stone."
lines.direction: Reading aloud from the wall, slowly; the language of her prayers.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: It was stone within forty years.
lines.say: It was stone within forty years.
lines.direction: Timed to the shutters opening on the plain (7.4).

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: We were chosen.
lines.say: We were chosen.
lines.direction: Reflex, quieter than she means.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: You were sheltered. (beat) By then you had gardens.
lines.say: You were sheltered. ... By then you had gardens.
lines.direction: Dry; the second sentence lands as plain fact.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: I drew where each one would fall. You sealed them.
lines.say: I drew where each one would fall. You sealed them.
lines.direction: Without accusation.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: The marriage bell.
lines.say: The marriage bell.
lines.direction: Barely voiced; recognition.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: Ninety tons. Anvil Vale, the same hour. The bearing-lands have been full since before you were born. Every bell is a mountain now.
lines.say: Ninety tons. Anvil Vale, the same hour. The bearing-lands have been full since before you were born. Every bell is a mountain now.
lines.direction: Even, a report.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: I did not read it.
lines.say: I did not read it.
lines.direction: Her bare hand on the shard; almost nothing in the voice.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: No one above reads them. That is how it was built. (beat) I read every one. And drew the next.
lines.say: No one above reads them. That is how it was built. ... I read every one. And drew the next.
lines.direction: Quiet; the last sentence the only guilt he shows.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: That will carry you. All of Orison. It is stone. It has no children. I can close the Weir a hand's breadth at a time and set you down as gently as you were lifted.
lines.say: That will carry you. All of Orison. It is stone. It has no children. I can close the Weir a hand's breadth at a time and set you down as gently as you were lifted.
lines.direction: Turned to the plain; the offer made plainly.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: And your price.
lines.say: And your price.
lines.direction: Level, the admiral again.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: The fleet at anchor, colours struck. And the bearing-lands are no longer yours.
lines.say: The fleet at anchor, colours struck. And the bearing-lands are no longer yours.
lines.direction: Terms, stated.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: You would have us fall.
lines.say: You would have us fall.
lines.direction: Low.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: No. We would have you come down.
lines.say: No. We would have you come down.
lines.direction: No heat at all.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: Four million people, disarmed, set down among eleven nations with every reason to hate them. What protects them?
lines.say: Four million people, disarmed, set down among eleven nations with every reason to hate them. What protects them?
lines.direction: The longest she speaks; still measured.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: Nothing. (beat) What has protected us?
lines.say: Nothing. ... What has protected us?
lines.direction: A real pause after "Nothing."

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: A truce. No hand raised against anyone who comes down unarmed, until the harvest is in. After that I can promise you nothing. (she is counting the seals) Ten. The eleventh is in the courtyard, handing out spears. (the wall) We kept that eight hundred years. Read it.
lines.say: A truce. No hand raised against anyone who comes down unarmed, until the harvest is in. After that I can promise you nothing. Ten. The eleventh is in the courtyard, handing out spears. We kept that eight hundred years. Read it.
lines.direction: Unhurried; "Read it" quiet, not a command.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: Give me time. I will put it to the Council --
lines.say: Give me time. I will put it to the Council --
lines.direction: Cut off by Karst.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: We gave you time once. You are still spending it.
lines.say: We gave you time once. You are still spending it.
lines.direction: Cuts across her. Dry.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: I will put it to them. If they refuse, I am still their admiral. Clear the vale by the evening bell.
lines.say: I will put it to them. If they refuse, I am still their admiral. Clear the vale by the evening bell.
lines.direction: Resolved; the old certainty, thinner.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: "I am still their engineer." I said that for nineteen years. It is a comfortable sentence.
lines.say: "I am still their engineer." I said that for nineteen years. It is a comfortable sentence.
lines.direction: Quoting himself, with no pleasure in it.

lines.speaker: C03
lines.name: Marl
lines.script: I dug for two days, Karst. My seal is not on your truce. (beat) All nine gates. All at once, before she fires. Let them learn it the way Anvil learned it.
lines.say: I dug for two days, Karst. My seal is not on your truce. ... All nine gates. All at once, before she fires. Let them learn it the way Anvil learned it.
lines.direction: Hoarse, hard, words like stones; breath of effort at the wheel.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: She has not fired.
lines.say: She has not fired.
lines.direction: Quiet, his hand on the pin.

lines.speaker: C07
lines.name: The Flag Captain
lines.script: The count, Admiral. Nine thousand clear of the vale. Of forty. (beat) They are carrying beds.
lines.say: The count, Admiral. Nine thousand clear of the vale. Of forty. ... They are carrying beds.
lines.direction: A report that breaks once, in the gap before the last sentence.

lines.speaker: C07
lines.name: The Flag Captain
lines.script: The Council's answer, Admiral. "What heaven has raised --"
lines.say: The Council's answer, Admiral. "What heaven has raised --"
lines.direction: He reads it and does not finish.

lines.speaker: C07
lines.name: The Flag Captain
lines.script: ...Guns, Admiral?
lines.say: ...Guns, Admiral?
lines.direction: Barely spoken.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: Anchors.
lines.say: Anchors.
lines.direction: Low, level, unforced. No tail.

lines.speaker: C07
lines.name: The Flag Captain
lines.script: From Vice Admiral Cassiel. "The bell has rung. The Grand Admiral is relieved. The fleet fires on my signal."
lines.say: From Vice Admiral Cassiel. "The bell has rung. The Grand Admiral is relieved. The fleet fires on my signal."
lines.direction: Reads it without wanting to.

lines.speaker: C01
lines.name: Serath
lines.script: He is within the law. You know what this is called.
lines.say: He is within the law. You know what this is called.
lines.direction: Plain; she lays the collar down.

lines.speaker: C07
lines.name: The Flag Captain
lines.script: I know what it is called. (to the bridge) Let go all anchors.
lines.say: I know what it is called. Let go all anchors.
lines.direction: Quiet resolve, then a clear order, not a shout.

lines.speaker: C03
lines.name: Marl
lines.script: I will not carry them. And I will not drop them.
lines.say: I will not carry them. And I will not drop them.
lines.direction: The catch in the throat, cut off.

lines.speaker: C02
lines.name: Karst
lines.script: Slowly.
lines.say: Slowly.
lines.direction: Almost to himself, hands on the wheel.
